description: Defines the WhoamiResponse class, a JSON-based response object for a 'Whoami' command in a gateway endpoint, including methods for creation, JSON serialization/deserialization, and header management.

classes.name: WhoamiResponse
classes.description: A final class representing the response to a 'Whoami' command, immutable, JSON-serializable, with header and entity management.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new WhoamiResponse instance from UserInformation and DittoHeaders.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a WhoamiResponse from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends the userInformation payload to a JSON object builder.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated DittoHeaders.

methods.name: setEntity
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified JSON entity.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on userInformation and superclass.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on userInformation and superclass.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns string representation including class name and userInformation.

methods.name: getSupportedSchemaVersions
methods.description: Returns supported JSON schema versions, specifically V_2.
